markets.name: Rank pattern
markets.description: How many distinct ranks the flop has.

markets.name: Flop hand
markets.description: The best three-card poker hand the flop makes (the app's main prediction grid). Every flop is exactly one of these.

selections.label: High card: no pair, flush or straight
Flush: three of the same suit, not in sequence
Straight: three in sequence, not all one suit

markets.name: Paired board
markets.description: Whether any rank appears at least twice (a pair or trips).

markets.name: Pair of a named rank
markets.description: Exactly two cards of the chosen rank (trips do not count).

markets.name: Paired rank low / high
markets.description: Exactly one pair, with the paired rank in the chosen band.

markets.name: Pair with a face-card kicker
markets.description: Exactly one pair and the unpaired card is J, Q or K.

markets.name: Suit pattern
markets.description: Number of distinct suits on the flop.

markets.name: All one named suit
markets.description: All three cards are of the chosen suit.

markets.name: Card colour
markets.description: Red = hearts and diamonds, black = spades and clubs.

markets.name: Number of red cards
markets.description: Exactly N red cards (hearts or diamonds).

markets.name: Number of spades
markets.description: Exactly N spades on the flop.

markets.name: Number of hearts
markets.description: Exactly N hearts on the flop.

markets.name: Number of diamonds
markets.description: Exactly N diamonds on the flop.

markets.name: Number of clubs
markets.description: Exactly N clubs on the flop.

markets.name: All cards below X
markets.description: Every card is strictly below the chosen rank (ace is high).

markets.name: All cards above X
markets.description: Every card is strictly above the chosen rank (ace is high).

markets.name: All cards in a range
markets.description: Every card is within the inclusive rank interval.

markets.name: At least one card above / below X
markets.description: At least one card strictly above (or below) the chosen rank.

selections.label: At least one above J (Q, K or A)

markets.name: Number of high cards (J or higher)
markets.description: Exactly N cards ranked J, Q, K or A.

markets.name: Highest card
markets.description: The rank of the highest card on the flop (ace is high).

markets.name: Lowest card
markets.description: The rank of the lowest card on the flop (ace is high).

markets.name: Number of face cards
markets.description: Exactly N face cards (J, Q, K). Three = "all images".

markets.name: Number of aces
markets.description: Exactly N aces on the flop.

markets.name: Any ace
markets.description: At least one ace / no ace.

markets.name: Contains a named rank
markets.description: At least one card of the chosen rank.

markets.name: Contains an exact card
markets.description: The chosen card is one of the three flop cards.

markets.name: All Broadway
markets.description: Every card is 10, J, Q, K or A.

markets.name: Ace and King
markets.description: The flop contains at least one ace and at least one king.

markets.name: Three-card straight
markets.description: Three consecutive distinct ranks. A-2-3 and Q-K-A count; K-A-2 does not.

markets.name: Three-card straight flush
markets.description: Three consecutive ranks, all of the same suit.

markets.name: Connected ranks
markets.description: Whether any two cards are adjacent in rank (A is adjacent to K and 2).

markets.name: One-gap sequence
markets.description: Three distinct ranks spanning four ranks with one gap, e.g. 5-6-8 or 5-7-8 (ace high only).

markets.name: Exact straight
markets.description: The flop ranks are exactly the chosen consecutive set, any suits.

markets.name: Rank spread (highest minus lowest)
markets.description: Highest rank minus lowest rank, ace high (0 = trips, maximum 12).

markets.name: Total over / under (24 loses both)
markets.description: Rank total over 24 or under 24. A total of exactly 24 (5.9%) loses both sides; it can be backed separately.

markets.name: Total over / under 20.5
markets.description: Rank total line 20.5.

markets.name: Total over / under 28.5
markets.description: Rank total line 28.5.

markets.name: Total band
markets.description: Rank total within the inclusive band.

markets.name: Exact total
markets.description: Rank total equals the chosen number (6..42). Extreme totals are too rare to offer.

markets.name: Total odd / even
markets.description: Parity of the rank total.

markets.name: Number of odd-ranked cards
markets.description: Exactly N cards with an odd rank value (3, 5, 7, 9, J=11, K=13).

markets.name: Combined conditions
markets.description: Both conditions must hold. Probabilities are counted jointly over all flops.

selections.label: Pair and at least one face card
